title: 里昂证券梁：AI变现路径，云业务最直接
speaker: Eleanor Leung

segments.en: Is there one company that you see that has a better AI monetization path?
segments.zh: 有没有一家公司，你认为它的AI变现路径更好？

segments.en: In terms of AI monetization, we see 2B is a lot more easy and it's more straightforward because you're just replacing the human workforce and that is very straightforward.
segments.zh: 在AI变现方面，我们看到2B容易得多，也更直接，因为你就是替代人力，这非常直接。

segments.en: And the company is very willing to pay for it because they can save costs on the personal costs.
segments.zh: 而且公司非常愿意为此付费，因为他们可以节省人力成本。

segments.en: So we think cloud is the best way to monetize, which Baba is the largest in China.
segments.zh: 所以我们认为云是最好的变现方式，而阿里在中国是最大的。

segments.en: They are not just the largest, they're going the fastest as well. So we think Baba is best positioned for that.
segments.zh: 他们不仅是最大的，也是增长最快的。所以我们认为阿里在这方面定位最好。

segments.en: But tens that also have a strong position in a long run is because they are good better in terms of application creation and also get better in to-see application.
segments.zh: 但腾讯在长期也有很强地位，因为他们在应用创建方面更好，在to-C应用上也变得更好。

segments.en: You can see a lot of the AI chamber around the world that struggle to monetize because they don't have the commerce ecosystem.
segments.zh: 你可以看到全球很多AI公司难以变现，因为他们没有商业生态。

segments.en: You have to monetize through transaction. If you don't have the common ecosystem, you cannot do transaction, it's very difficult for you to monetize in the future.
segments.zh: 你必须通过交易来变现。如果你没有商业生态，你就无法做交易，未来变现会非常困难。

segments.en: We see that by dense struggling, matter to struggling, but tens that already have a fantastic ecosystem there, where they have 4 million mini-program, a million daily active users.
segments.zh: 我们看到有些公司在挣扎，但腾讯已经拥有极好的生态，有400万小程序、100万日活用户。

segments.en: They already have relationship with all these JD, PDD, Maituan, they can easily form a partnership with them, be able to collaborate with them and sell stuff on their ecosystem.
segments.zh: 他们已经与京东、拼多多、美团建立了关系，可以轻松与他们合作，在自己的生态上销售商品。
